verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a SaaS calendar assistant that processes users' schedules, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents retention settings, data deletion, or account or data purge controls. The #nosync hashtag only stops individual events from syncing, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
